name: Messages Improved
summary: Group MMS fixes, a faster inbox and iMessage
description: Improves the stock Messages app and its providers. Group MMS goes to the right thread, and conversations open faster. Optional iMessage through your own imsg-server: pair with a code under Settings > Advanced settings and the phone registers its number, with SMS fallback.
author: thooton

changes.text: Defer MessagingNotification.init (with lazy sPduPersister), Contact ContentObserver IPC, and non-critical background threads past frame 1.
Lazy-init ThumbnailManager (skipping 2 sync PNG decodes) and PduLoaderManager in MmsApp, thread-safe main-looper BackgroundLoaderManager, defer CountryDetector getSystemService IPC.
Defer DownloadManager/RateController init (with lazy getInstance), MessagingNotification receiver registration, and DraftCache initial SQLite refresh past frame 1.
Zero-alloc ASCII and direct UTF-8 fast path in MessageUtils.extractEncStrFromCursor, drop presentMessage StringBuilder Log.v.
Drop per-row Log.d/v in MessageListItem inflate/init, cache integer and bool resources in ComposeMessageActivity.initResourceRefs, guard inbox snippet setText.
1:1 zero-tokenizer single-lock WaveRecipientCache fast path, lazy-missing single-lock group path, pre-size WavePhoneSnapshot HashMap and raise prime thread priority.
Preload all tapback reactions off-main in single query, zero-alloc drawTapbackGlyph and single-reaction badgesFor, cache cell broadcast PackageManager check.
Cache runtime permission grants per process in MessageUtils.checkPermissionsIfNeeded/hasBasicPermissions to skip 14-16 PackageManager Binder IPCs per Activity open.
Share immutable ForegroundColorSpan and drop Log.v in MessageListItem.<init>, cache default send button drawables in onResume, guard inbox date setText.
Reuse LetterTileDrawable in-place for named contacts, guard QuickContactBadge setImageDrawable/setVisibility, cache inbox row height dimensions.
